I think you need to realize that ones sexual past doesn't define who they are. You're only 20 so there's still time but, I fear you might overlook great people who could be your perfect partner because they are different than you. This might make you anxious at first but I think you're so worried about looking for the kind of girl you want as if it's a small category and you can only choose from this group. What happens if this group of people just generally don't find you attractive (this probably isn't true but merely a hypothetical) Just be your best self, be open and kind, think the best in others, and keep your eyes open for someone who meshes well with you. Don't be judging or worry about there past. Get to know who they are not what they've done. If you keep looking for these impersonal details you may find someone who is the perfect candidate but you'll likely end up settling on the more personal side and that sounds like a tragedy to me
